import_provenance.original_title: The optimal deterministic price of obligatory testing
import_provenance.original_statement: What is the optimal deterministic competitive ratio for minimizing total completion time on one machine when all jobs are initially present, each requires a known-duration test, and its processing time is revealed only by that test? Tests and processing operations are individually nonpreemptive; the general-test-time gap is between √2 and 1.861.
